name: Nacht
source: [spoiler]The main villain of the story who has a close relationship with Graves. He claims to have a lot of patience, but is shown to be good at fighting both with fists and magic. Nacht's original magic is paper magic, but he stole part of Grave's metal magic, causing the metal magic to become rust.
